jobs.title: Senior Engineer - AI Workflows
jobs.description: As a Senior Engineer within the Internal AI Accelerator Squad, you will be at the forefront of Xero's transformation into an AI-native company, acting as a forward-deployed engineer, embedding yourself within various internal business teams to co-design and operationalise agentic AI workflows that remove manual toil and fundamentally reshape how our people work end-to-end. Key responsibilities include: Designing and iterating on AI agents and workflow orchestrations using tools like Claude, Gemini, and MCP; Integrating AI systems with core enterprise platforms including Salesforce, Workday, Slack, and NetSuite; Developing reusable automation patterns and shared templates to be used by the business and building evaluation and monitoring frameworks to measure performance and ensure the safety of AI-native workflows; Leading the delivery of high-stakes AI agents from discovery to production, while acting as a technical partner and evangelist. Requirements: You bring a wealth of experience in building and operating applications or automations within production environments, particularly involving APIs and cloud infrastructure. Hands-on delivery of AI-driven solutions such as agents, copilots, or RAG systems using LLMs like Claude or Gemini.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern, Data Trust & Safety (Australia) - 2026 Start
jobs.description: The Trust & Safety (T&S) team at TikTok helps ensure that the global online community is safe and empowered to create and enjoy content across all applications, with heavy investment in human and machine-based moderation to remove harmful content quickly and often before it reaches the general community. Responsibilities include building industry-leading content safety systems for TikTok and developing highly-scalable classifiers, tools, models and algorithms leveraging cutting-edge machine learning, computer vision and data mining technologies. Minimum Qualifications: Currently pursuing a bachelor's degree or have completed one within 1 year in Computer Science or a related engineering field; solid knowledge in at least one of: machine learning, pattern recognition, NLP, data mining, or computer vision; firm understanding of data structures and algorithms.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer Graduate, Trust and Safety Engineering - 2026 Start
jobs.description: The Trust & Safety (T&S) team at TikTok helps ensure that the global online community is safe and empowered to create and enjoy content across TikTok's applications, having invested heavily in human and machine-based moderation to remove harmful content quickly. The role involves working with world-class engineers to build industry-leading trust and safety systems, developing and building highly-scalable classifiers, tools, models and algorithms leveraging cutting-edge machine learning, computer vision and data mining technologies, improving trust and safety strategy and working on model iterations. Minimum Qualifications: Currently pursuing your bachelor's or completed within 1 year in Computer Science or related engineering field; solid knowledge in at least one of: machine learning, pattern recognition, NLP, data mining, or computer vision; firm understanding of data structures and algorithms; great communication and teamwork skills.

jobs.title: 2026 DXC Technology Graduate Program - AI Engineer
jobs.description: As a Graduate AI Engineer, you will be exposed to our leading experts around the globe and contribute directly to our product. You will have the opportunity to join a DXC team based in Melbourne and Sydney who are actively engineering the future of enterprise autonomy. The current focus areas are AIOps & AI Governance, where you will engineer the platforms and CI/CD pipelines for AI deployment, automated model monitoring, performance tracking, and governance. This is a critical component that ensures AI is scalable, reliable, secure, and deployed responsibly across the enterprise. Eligibility Requirements: You must have completed all course requirements for your degree no earlier than November 2023, and must be expecting to complete all course requirements for your degree no later than February 2026.

jobs.title: Graduate Data Scientist / Data Engineer
jobs.description: As a Graduate Data Scientist or Graduate Data Engineer, you'll join a collaborative analytics and data delivery team supporting mission-critical programs for our customers. You'll work on meaningful projects that turn data into insights, insights into action, and engineering into robust, secure data solutions. Depending on your background and interests, you may focus on analytics, data modelling or data engineering—or build experience across all three as part of your early career development. Requirements: You must be an Australian Citizen and able to obtain and maintain an active Top Secret AGSVA security clearance (TSPV). Leidos Australia delivers IT and airborne solutions that protect and advance the Australian way of life, with 2000 local experts backed by global experience.

jobs.title: 2026 Applied Science Intern (Machine Learning, Recommender Systems)
jobs.description: Key job responsibilities include developing novel solutions and building prototypes, working on complex problems in Machine Learning and Information Retrieval, contributing to research that could significantly impact Amazon operations, and collaborating with a diverse team of experts in a fast-paced environment. You will take on complex problems, work on solutions that leverage existing academic and industrial research, and utilize your own out-of-the-box pragmatic thinking. In addition to coming up with novel solutions and prototypes, you may even deliver these to production in customer facing products. The successful intern is required to be based in Melbourne; relocation allowance is provided if based outside Melbourne. Duration: 6 months full-time, starting Jan-March 2026.

jobs.title: 游戏AI算法实习生

jobs.title: 大模型算法实习生
